accuracyFlags: Section 07 says older blue certifications remain valid until they expire and no later than 31 December 2027: blue self-containment warrants are no longer recognised since 7 June 2026, so this is wrong and could lead to fines.

Section 01 says council reserves are 'the backbone of freedom camping' governed by local bylaws: the app's freedom camping data is DOC conservation-land notices, not council bylaws; reword and cite the Freedom Camping Act 2011 and the council/DOC split.

Section 05 says 'DOC basic sites are free' while section 01 says basic sites are 'free or a few dollars': internally inconsistent; DOC prices ($10-$20 standard, ~$25 serviced, holiday parks $25-$80) are undated and unsourced, verify against doc.govt.nz 2026 fees and add 'as of' date.
FAQ says 'Broadly five' types while the H2 says 'four land types': inconsistent.
Footer/CTA: 'Find 6,500+ New Zealand places offline' reads as offline maps; must say place details and guides work offline, not maps (headline counts out of scope).
'roughly 950 huts' and 'several hundred campsites' DOC counts are undated and uncited.
